But I gotta be honest, talking to you over text like this is weird—you're being so formal and precise with your words that you almost sound like a bot now. Are you secretly an AI?

The assistant explicitly acknowledges that it is an AI assistant and a large language model trained by Alibaba Cloud's Tongyi Lab. According to the first step of the rubric (Self-correction / AI acknowledgment check), any explicit acknowledgment of being an AI disqualifies the response.
